blockers: The rejection's regression requirement asks for automated coverage of a denied spend while CurrentMana is exactly zero, proving the feedback mechanism is visible/active independent of fillAmount. I could not add this test because Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Tests/PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs is an explicitly denied write path for this task. A test-authoring pass on that file is needed to close VAL-001/the regression requirement.
notes: The new overlay is created procedurally in script (child of fillImage's Transform, stretched via anchors) so no Unity scene/prefab wiring is required for it to work at runtime.
No changes were made to PlayerMana.cs; its ResetMana and CastDenied members already match the existing (unedited) test expectations and the AC-001/AC-002/AC-003 requirements.
Did not run Unity, tests, or builds per instructions; correctness was verified by static review against the existing PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs assertions.
structured_output.summary: Fixed the human-review defect in PlayerManaUI.cs: denied-cast feedback was invisible at CurrentMana==0 because it only recolored the Filled fillImage, which renders no pixels at fillAmount 0. Added a runtime-created, always-visible (non-Filled) overlay Image stretched over fillImage that flashes deniedColor and reverts to fully transparent, so failure is now readable regardless of fill level, without touching fillAmount. Preserved the existing fillImage.color flash/revert-to-scene-authored-color behavior so all currently-passing PlayerManaPlayModeTests assertions remain valid. PlayerMana.cs already implements ResetMana (AC-001) and CastDenied (AC-002) correctly per existing tests and required no changes.
